scheme_name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Incentive for Basic and Essential Common Infrastructure Facilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a private‑sector entity or an existing/operational industrial park
Minimum of 5 acres of legally owned land (by direct purchase or lease from the State Government) is required
The Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must be registered under the Companies Act, Societies Registration Act, Partnership Act or LLP
Park area must be expanded to at least 5 acres in out‑lying districts and at least 2 acres in Kolkata and Howrah
All individual units within the park must have obtained necessary clearances for land conversion, fire licence, environmental compliance, building plan, etc.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time back‑ended capital subsidy ranging from ₹2 crore to ₹10 crore based on the park’s land area, with up to 20% earmarked for plant and equipment in the Common Facility Centre.
